name: What is remodel planning and scope coordination?
description: It's the process of defining your remodel goals, budget, and coordinating plans with professionals before construction.

mainEntity.name: What is remodel planning and scope coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: Remodel planning and scope coordination is the initial phase of a construction project where all aspects of the remodel are defined. This includes establishing your goals, desired aesthetics, functional requirements, and budget. It also involves coordinating with architects, designers, and engineers to create detailed plans and specifications, ensuring everyone involved understands the project's boundaries and objectives before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's the process of defining your remodel goals, budget, and coordinating plans with professionals before construction.
